p/p.synod:3:7: error[reserved-word]: "to" is a reserved word and cannot be a field
  |
3 |   set to to 0
  |       ^^

p/p.synod:6:1: error[reserved-word]: "list" is a reserved word and cannot be a record type
  |
6 | list has
  | ^^^^

p/p.synod:9:8: error[reserved-word]: "if" is a reserved word and cannot be a phrase head
  |
9 | define if [a: number]
  |        ^^

p/p.synod:12:14: error[reserved-word]: "to" is a reserved word and cannot be a hole name
   |
12 | define Send [to: node]
   |              ^^

p/p.synod:13:7: error[reserved-word]: "plus" is a reserved word and cannot be a name
   |
13 |   set plus to 1
   |       ^^^^

p/p.synod:14:8: error[reserved-word]: "by" is a reserved word and cannot be a name
   |
14 |   each by in {1}
   |        ^^
